verdict.rationale: Composio's docs show first-party SDK client code (composio.sessions.create, composio.mcp.create) and provider adapters that turn Composio tools into framework-native formats, which points to an official SDK developers build against. The pack never explicitly names, versions, or describes installation of the official SDKs, so coverage stays partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDK packages and supported languages, install/reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: A provider is the adapter that turns Composio tools into the native tool format your framework expects, so you don't write glue code.
Composio works with any AI framework.
